# FG-AGENT-0013

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 422 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `mcp_external_host_rejected` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: MCP の行き先が社内の許可の一覧にありません。社外のサービスにはつなげません。
- en: The MCP endpoint is not on the internal allow-list. External services cannot be connected.
- id: Endpoint MCP tidak ada dalam daftar izin internal. Layanan eksternal tidak dapat dihubungkan.

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 16 §8, contract 8 (on-prem; ADR-0032 §5): a part's `.mcp.json` names an `http(s)://` or `ws(s)://` URL — in `url`, `args`, `env` or anywhere in a server's definition — whose host is not on the allow-list (`mcp_host_not_allowed`; an exact host, or a `.suffix` entry matching a subdomain only). With no list, every URL is refused.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

`gstn agent verify --part <dir> --mcp-allowed-hosts <a,b> --json`: `subject` is the host refused.

## 対処 (fix)

Point the MCP server at an internal host on the list, or ask the administrator to add the internal host to the list. External hosts are not allowed.
